revised_prompts: Photorealistic unedited safety-inspection camera frame, 1920x1080 landscape, fixed camera mounted about 1.5 meters above the floor in an office corridor. Moderate side view from a moderate distance, natural perspective, realistic scale, enough surrounding context to judge body support. Environment: office corridor with glass partitions and doors, practical overhead fluorescent/LED lights, rubberized safety flooring, partial shadow from nearby structure, clear subject detail, ordinary photographic look with restrained contrast. Visible subject: an older adult woman with a small build, wearing a beige coat over black and teal clothing, comfortable shoes, in a stable kneeling pose facing slightly away from the camera; body upright and supported, not flattened on the floor. Practical clutter kept behind the subject, no foreground obstruction. No text, no captions, no watermark, no logo, no warning label, no overlay, no bounding box, no arrow, no circle, no artificial annotation.
